factual_errors.claim: Connect the controller to a regulated 24 V DC supply
factual_errors.why_wrong: Ground truth states three-phase AC power stability is a known root cause; AC 01.2 requires 3-phase AC power, not 24V DC

factual_errors.claim: Locate the programming port on the AC 01.2 (usually a 6-pin mini-DIN or RJ45). Attach the AUMA USB-to-RS-485 cable
factual_errors.why_wrong: Ground truth specifies recovery via Bluetooth (AUMA CDT) or SD card only; no USB/serial programming port documented

factual_errors.claim: If the unit has a USB-bootloader port, use that instead
factual_errors.why_wrong: No USB-bootloader port exists in AC 01.2 per ground truth or AUMA documentation

factual_errors.claim: Open AUMA Service Suite... Select 'Bootloader/Recovery Mode'
factual_errors.why_wrong: Ground truth specifies AUMA CDT (Bluetooth) or SD card methods only; no generic 'Service Suite' bootloader mode

factual_errors.claim: From the AUMA support portal, retrieve the exact firmware package
factual_errors.why_wrong: Ground truth: firmware must come directly from AUMA service and is model/serial-specific; cannot be downloaded from public portal

factual_errors.claim: Some AC 01.2 units store the bootloader in a separate flash sector... choose 'Bootloader Update'
factual_errors.why_wrong: Ground truth describes full firmware recovery via CDT or SD card, not separate bootloader update; not documented in authorized procedure
